definitions.explanation: Completely black without any other color; extremely dark.
Having darkened significantly from sun exposure.
Colloquial: obviously guilty or corrupt (opposite of 'innocent').

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っ{黒|くろ}な⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧だ。

examples.english: The sky was covered with pitch-black clouds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焦|こ}がして→焦がす：06677_kogasu⟧しまって、⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{底|そこ}→底：12560_soko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{黒|くろ}になった。
examples.english: I burned it, and the bottom of the pot turned pitch black.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日焼|ひや}け→日焼け：15469_hiyake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{真|ま}っ{黒|くろ}だ。
examples.english: I'm really tanned from the sun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{真|ま}っ{黒|くろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日焼|ひや}けした→日焼けする：20314_hiyakesuru⟧。
examples.english: I got really tanned over summer vacation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧すぎて、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{真|ま}っ{黒|くろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{焼|や}けて→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧きた。
examples.english: The children played too much at the beach and came home deeply tanned.

examples.japanese: ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{真|ま}っ{黒|くろ}だ。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{真|ま}っ{黒|くろ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: That politician is said to be totally corrupt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きて、⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{真|ま}っ{黒|くろ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧わかった。
examples.english: As evidence kept coming out one after another, it became clear the suspect was totally guilty.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{真|ま}っ (emphatic prefix) + ⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧ (black)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {真|ま}っ{黒|くろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{焦|こ}げる→焦げる：05344_kogeru⟧ - to burn black
- {真|ま}っ{黒|くろ}な⟦{夜空|よぞら}→夜空：09591_yozora⟧ - pitch-black night sky
- {真|ま}っ{黒|くろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧ - jet-black hair

COLLOQUIAL USAGE:
In colloquial Japanese, {真|ま}っ{黒|くろ} (innocent: ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧) is used to describe someone clearly guilty or corrupt, like the English "guilty as sin."

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}→真っ白：07613_masshiro⟧ - pure white
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}→真っ暗：07616_makkura⟧ - pitch dark
